title: A Dispute at the Garage
body: The Russo Motor Works is having a disagreement between two mechanics over the use of a specific tool. One says the other borrowed it without asking, and the other claims it was left behind. I can’t have this turning into a fight, not with the Bellandi men watching. If you can talk them into splitting the space or sharing the tool, I’ll owe you a favor.
speaker: elena
outcome: You completed the requested mediation without violence. You pushed the schedule and drew more attention.

approaches.label: Check the garage for the tool before negotiating
Push for a prompt agreement to avoid delays
